This certificate is presented to Adeolu Adeola Abayomi for participating in the Genomac Malaria Innovation Competition, organized by Genomac Holdings in commemoration of World Malaria Week.

This recognition acknowledges your contribution to advancing innovative perspectives and supporting efforts toward malaria awareness and intervention.
